research_question: RQ1 supervised radar-to-ECG reconstruction: choose the final REM-Net morphology configuration without using final test folds for model selection.
hypothesis: The current no-alignment REM-Net recipe is close to optimal, but a small controlled sweep over morphology/event loss weights and decoder capacity may improve or stabilize Shape-200 morphology across MMECG and CR_RVS.
selection_metric: development-fold validation/checkpoint morphology behavior; test-fold shape-head PCC is diagnostic only during F0
success_criteria: Promote only if dev-fold mean PCC beats the incumbent by >=0.003 or gives a consistent cross-dataset/region-diagnostic gain without hard-fold regression.
failure_interpretation: If no candidate clears the gate, freeze the incumbent rather than continuing open-ended tuning.
estimated_cost: 36 fold-level train/eval jobs at 35 epochs; intended as a single sequential background batch.
